summary.name: KubeWeekly
summary.one_liner: KubeWeekly is a weekly email newsletter and web archive of curated Kubernetes news, articles and webinars, running from 2015 to 2025.

Finding curated Kubernetes articles and webinars
Browsing past KubeWeekly issues from 2015 to 2025
Subscribing to Kubernetes news via RSS
Submitting an article for consideration in the newsletter
summary.what_it_does: KubeWeekly is a weekly newsletter delivering curated Kubernetes news to subscribers' inboxes. The page lists an archive of issues dated from March 2015 through May 2025, with issue titles such as "KubeWeekly #404" and featured items like a Kubernetes Live webinar on architecture. Readers can follow it via RSS. The site also has a form for submitting articles for consideration. The page names a team of curators, listed in the meta description.
notable: Weekly curated Kubernetes news with an issue archive dating back to 2015
Open submission form for community articles
caveats: The page does not state the subscription price explicitly; pricing is inferred as free from the absence of any paid tier.
Archive appears to stop at May 2025 issues on this capture.
